title: hypericum mutilum var. minus
intro: Hypericum mutilum var. minus, commonly known as Dwarf St. John's Wort, is a shrubby perennial plant that belongs to the Hypericaceae family. It is native to Europe and Western Asia, and is traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The plant has been used therapeutically to treat wounds, skin conditions, and anxiety, with its therapeutic actions attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation and promote tissue repair. The bioactive constituents of Dwarf St. John's Wort include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and hyperforin, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
